At Fairway Carts, we believe great service starts with genuine care. Based in Minden, Louisiana, we’re more than just a business — we’re your local partners in quality, performance, and reliability. Our team is passionate about helping our community find the right golf carts, utility vehicles, and lawn equipment to make life easier and more enjoyable.

We take pride in offering a personalized experience for every customer. Whether you’re looking to upgrade your ride on the golf course, handle tough work around your property, or maintain beautiful grounds, we take the time to understand your needs and recommend the best solutions. Every product we sell is chosen for its durability and performance, ensuring you get the lasting value and dependability you deserve.

At the heart of Fairway Carts is a commitment to honesty, trust, and community. We’re here to build long-term relationships — not just make sales. From expert guidance to friendly, ongoing support, our goal is to help you find the perfect fit and keep it running smoothly for years to come.

Fairway Carts: where quality, service, and Southern pride drive everything we do.
